newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain police say break major crime network,hold 42.
newsitem.headline: Spain police say break major crime network,hold 42.

text.p: Spanish police said on Wednesday they had smashed a major international crime ring, arresting 42 suspects in drug trafficking, hold-ups, money laundering and armed robbery.
Police said most of those held were from former Yugoslavia but also included Germans, Albanians and Spaniards.
"We have broken one of the most important criminal networks for many years. We expect to make more arrests," police said.

Police broke the ring on Tuesday when they raided 13 houses throughout Madrid after an operation lasting 10 months. Police said they also confiscated guns, false Italian identity cards and tools used in robberies.
